neighbours.label: the second piece of step and zig-zag compounds (zig-z|ag, step|wise, schritt|weise)
fire: The river winds in a lazy zigzag through the flat green valley.
Hikers followed the zig-zag trail down to the old mill.
The new tax will be introduced stepwise between 2027 and 2030.
Die Regierung will die Steuer schrittweise senken.
Sew a zig-zag stitch along the raw edge to stop fraying.
We solved the equations stepwise, checking each result.
Der Ausbau erfolgt schrittweise bis zum Jahr 2030.
Lightning drew a bright zigzag across the night sky.
quiet: The river winds in a lazy curve through the flat green valley.
Hikers followed the narrow trail down to the old mill.
The new tax will be introduced gradually between 2027 and 2030.
Die Regierung will die Steuer deutlich senken.
Sew a straight stitch along the raw edge to stop fraying.
We solved the equations carefully, checking each result.
Der Ausbau erfolgt vollständig bis zum Jahr 2030.
Lightning drew a bright line across the night sky.

notes: Card: 'zag' x5, 'ag' x4, 'wise' x4, 'weise' x2, 'periodised'. Probe: zig-zag 0.87, stepwise 0.52, schrittweise 0.87, but clockwise and likewise ~0.01, so not every '-wise'.
